messages:
jess: Heads up — starting ~09:00 UTC we're getting 503s for SAML ACS POSTs coming through idp-metadata-service after the cert rotation. Logs show 'metadata parse error: invalid X509 block'.

deploy-bot: [info] rolled idp-metadata-service v2.3.1 at 08:58 UTC (canary -> 100%).

raj: Noted. Can you paste the redacted SAMLResponse and the exact lines from the service logs?

jess: dropped base64 into #secure-snippets. Log excerpt below:
```
2026-03-21T08:59:12Z idp-metadata: ERROR parse.go:87: failed to parse cert PEM: unexpected PEM block type "CERTIFICATECHAIN"
2026-03-21T08:59:12Z sso-proxy: WARN acs.go:134: validateAssertion: audience mismatch or signature invalid
```

alice-sec: That "CERTIFICATECHAIN" type suggests the IdP started publishing a chained PEM bundle. Our parser assumed a single CERTIFICATE block and choked. Signature verify fails -> we return 503.

carmen: Could this be related to the KMS rotation we did yesterday for SSO signing keys?

raj: Parser error points to metadata parsing, so KMS is less likely the direct cause, but a KMS alias race could cause some assertions to be signed with different keys which would surface as signature invalids. Check sso-audit logs: `grep SIGN /var/log/sso-audit.log | tail -n 50`.

ops-oncall: Running the grep now. Seeing `signer: lookup key alias redwood/sso-signing returned not found` around 08:57, then follow-up success entries. Matches the deploy window.

jess: Two working hypotheses: 1) parser change in v2.3.1 can't handle chained PEMs, 2) transient KMS alias lookups caused signers to flip during rotation. Both could be compounding.

alice-sec: Immediate mitigations: roll back idp-metadata-service to the previous release on canary, clear metadata cache, and add a defensive parser path that accepts multiple PEM blocks and picks the first CERTIFICATE for verification.

carmen: On SCIM we saw a surge of deprovision events coincident with the SSO failures. I'll pause auto-deprovision workers and throttle the SCIM queue until SSO is stable.

raj: I'll prepare a hotfix for the parser. Quick snippet I want to push to handle bundles:
```
func parseCertBundle(p []byte) (*x509.Certificate, error) {
  for {
    block, rest := pem.Decode(p)
    if block == nil { break }
    if block.Type == "CERTIFICATE" { return x509.ParseCertificate(block.Bytes) }
    p = rest
  }
  return nil, errors.New("no certificate block found")
}
```

deploy-bot: rollback requested by @alice-sec. Rolling idp-metadata-service -> v2.3.0 now.

ops-oncall: Rollback finished. Clearing metadata cache via `POST /internal/metadata/clear`. SCIM queue paused.

jess: After rollback test users show ACS -> 200. Production traffic ramping; monitoring window 10m.

alice-sec: Action items for postmortem: 1) add unit + integration tests for chained cert bundles, 2) emit KMS alias resolution fallback metrics into sso-audit, 3) coordinate cert/key rotations with metadata-parser compatibility checks, 4) wire a canary traffic healthcheck for SSO endpoints.

carmen: I'll write a SCIM contingency runbook (pause/resume steps + checklist) and link rollback steps.

raj: Opening a PR with the parser fix, marking high priority. Also adding an integration test that pulls chained bundles from Okta staging metadata endpoints.

jess: Thanks. Keep this thread open until audit logs show no more validation failures and SCIM workers resume.

ops-oncall: Current metrics: SAML validation error rate dropped from ~8% to ~0.1%. SCIM deprov paused at ~08:59 UTC; plan to resume at 10:20 UTC after verification.

alice-sec: Filing vuln-triage note: classify as a high-priority regression from an assumption change in parser. Not an auth vuln, but caused availability and provisioning churn. Tracking in GH: infra/sec#987.

jess: Final check — ensure next KMS alias rotation won't return temporary not-found errors. @carmen please add to ops pre-rotate checklist.

carmen: Done — added to checklist (:white_check_mark:).

jess: Thanks all :thumbsup:
